description: This file contains helper functions and builder types for constructing Kubernetes RBAC PolicyRules and ClusterRoleBindings programmatically, including validation logic.

classes.name: PolicyRuleBuilder
classes.description: A builder for constructing rbacv1alpha1.PolicyRule objects with validation.

classes.name: ClusterRoleBindingBuilder
classes.description: A builder for constructing rbacv1alpha1.ClusterRoleBinding objects with validation.

methods.name: Groups
methods.description: Adds groups to the PolicyRule or ClusterRoleBinding.

methods.name: Names
methods.description: Adds resource names to the PolicyRule.

methods.name: URLs
methods.description: Adds non-resource URLs to the PolicyRule.

methods.name: RuleOrDie
methods.description: Returns the constructed PolicyRule or panics if invalid.

methods.name: Rule
methods.description: Validates and returns the constructed PolicyRule.

methods.name: BindingOrDie
methods.description: Returns the constructed ClusterRoleBinding or panics if invalid.

methods.name: Binding
methods.description: Validates and returns the constructed ClusterRoleBinding.

methods.name: SAs
methods.description: Adds service accounts to the ClusterRoleBinding.
